editorial:
Imagine if the world's best kung fu masters decided to play professional soccer. That is exactly what you get here. You will follow a guy who believes that martial arts can save the sport of soccer, even though everyone thinks he is crazy. He tracks down his old brothers, who have all given up on their dreams and are working boring jobs, to build a dream team. The vibe is totally wild and doesn't take itself seriously for a second. It is basically a live-action cartoon where the characters can kick the ball so hard it turns into a fire-breathing dragon. 

What really makes this work is the comedy and the crazy special effects. While the CGI looks a bit dated now, it actually adds to the charm. The pacing is fast, and the action scenes are a blast to watch. If you love goofy humor and over-the-top fights, you will have a great time. You should definitely try streaming it in 4K Ultra HD on Prime Video to see all the action clearly, or maybe rent it on Apple TV for a quick movie night with friends. It is just a pure, fun experience that makes you feel good.
endingExplained: In the big final match, the team faces a group of bullies who use dirty tricks to win. Just when it looks like they will lose, the main character remembers his training and uses a super powerful move to score. He kicks the ball with so much force that it destroys everything in its path. They win the game, prove their skills, and finally find peace and respect through the sport of soccer.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves goofy comedies and high-energy action.
